summary: Built a CycloneDX SBOM of licence-demo with syft 1.57.2 (6 npm components from package-lock.json) and checked it against fixtures/license-policy.yaml. One shipped component is denied: lab-pdf-render 0.9.0 declares GPL-3.0-only. lab-legacy-codec declares no licence, lab-geo-tiles (MPL-2.0) needs review, and lab-date-utils is dual-licensed MIT OR GPL-3.0-only, taken as MIT. Not covered: syft leaves dev dependencies out of the SBOM, so lab-test-reporter (AGPL-3.0-only, dev) was read from the lockfile by hand; licences are as declared in the lockfile, no LICENSE file was available to compare. This is an engineering check, not legal advice.

tools_run.name: jq
tools_run.command: jq -r '.components[] | select(.type != "file") | [.name, .version, ([.licenses[]? | .expression // .license.id // .license.name] | join(" ; "))] | @tsv' evidence/artifacts/sbom.cdx.json | sort > evidence/artifacts/licences.tsv

findings.title: Shipped dependency lab-pdf-render 0.9.0 is licensed GPL-3.0-only (denied by policy)
findings.description: lab-pdf-render 0.9.0 is a direct runtime dependency (package.json dependencies, no dev flag in package-lock.json) and declares GPL-3.0-only, which is on the deny list for shipped code. The project itself is Apache-2.0.

proof.poc: jq '.results[] | select(.decision=="deny")' evidence/artifacts/licence-check.json && jq '.components[] | select(.name=="lab-pdf-render") | {name, version, licenses}' evidence/artifacts/sbom.cdx.json

findings.remediation: Replace lab-pdf-render with a component under an allowed licence, or get a written exception from the policy owner before the next release.

hypotheses.title: lab-legacy-codec 3.1.0 declares no licence
hypotheses.rationale: The lockfile entry has no license field and the target contains no LICENSE file for this package. No declared licence means no grant of rights, but the package may carry a licence file in its tarball.
hypotheses.next_step: Read the LICENSE file in the published package, or ask the maintainer. The policy sets unknown: review, so this is a review item.

hypotheses.title: lab-geo-tiles 1.2.0 is licensed MPL-2.0 (review list)
hypotheses.rationale: MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft. It is acceptable when the component is used unmodified.
hypotheses.next_step: Confirm that no file of lab-geo-tiles is modified or copied into the project source.

hypotheses.title: Dev dependency lab-test-reporter 4.0.0 is licensed AGPL-3.0-only
hypotheses.rationale: AGPL-3.0-only is on the deny list, but package-lock.json marks the package dev: true and the policy applies to shipped code. syft does not list it in the SBOM.
hypotheses.next_step: Confirm the test reporter is not bundled into the release artefact or the production image.
